degree3_clause_collapse.statement: Eliminating the actually selected degree-3 pivot produces at most four distinct raw clauses.
proof: If the pivot is pure, one polarity bucket is empty and only m-3=2 retained clauses remain.
If mixed, a degree-3 pivot has polarity split {1,2}; there are m-3=2 retained clauses and at most 1*2=2 distinct resolvents.
Therefore raw clause count <=2+2=4. Tautology removal, duplicate suppression and canonical subsumption can only reduce it.

finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N46
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit the proved N<=45 v0.5 frontier. At N=46, the standard partition gives r<=10 in the hard region. r<=8 is covered by the existing recurrence. r=9 is covered because the selector chooses d<=3; d<=2 reroots and d=3 gives B_x<=41 followed by an exact tail below cap. The only r=10 hard cell is m=5,L=30. There the selector chooses d<=3; d<=2 reroots, while d=3 forces all degrees to equal 3 and one exact elimination leaves at most four raw clauses, after which the existing m<=4 invariant keeps every continuing step below cap. Thus every legitimate N<=46 root is covered by the finite structural proof without invoking v2/v3 due to raw-cap unavailability.
